events.title: Edict of Thessalonica makes Nicene Christianity Rome's state faith
events.description: Emperors Theodosius I, Gratian and Valentinian II decreed that all subjects should follow the Christianity of the bishops of Rome and Alexandria. Other Christians were branded heretics.
events.html: Emperors Theodosius I, Gratian and Valentinian II decreed that all subjects should follow the Christianity of the bishops of Rome and Alexandria. Other Christians were branded heretics.

events.title: Abaoji becomes khagan of the Khitans
events.description: Abaoji, the Khitan leader later known as Emperor Taizu of Liao, became khagan of the Khitans. Breaking with the custom of rotating leadership, he proclaimed himself emperor in 916 and built a state combining steppe and Chinese institutions.

events.title: Henry IV crowned King of France at Chartres
events.description: A former Protestant who had converted to Catholicism, Henry was crowned at Chartres because Reims was held by the Catholic League. His Edict of Nantes in 1598 ended the Wars of Religion.
events.html: A former Protestant who had converted to Catholicism, Henry was crowned at Chartres because Reims was held by the Catholic League. His Edict of Nantes in 1598 ended the Wars of Religion.

events.title: Sweden and Russia sign the Treaty of Stolbovo
events.description: The Treaty of Stolbovo ended the Ingrian War between Sweden and Russia. Sweden returned Novgorod, which it had occupied, but kept Ingria and Kexholm, cutting Russia off from the Baltic Sea.
events.html: The Treaty of Stolbovo ended the Ingrian War between Sweden and Russia. Sweden returned Novgorod, which it had occupied, but kept Ingria and Kexholm, cutting Russia off from the Baltic Sea.

events.title: Yuan Chonghuan is appointed Governor of Liaodong after Ningyuan
events.description: After his cannon-armed defence of Ningyuan halted Nurhaci's army, the Ming court made Yuan Chonghuan Governor of Liaodong, with full authority over all forces outside the passes. He later executed the general Mao Wenlong, making powerful enemies.

events.title: An Organic Act places the District of Columbia under Congress
events.description: The District of Columbia Organic Act formally placed the district under the control of the United States Congress and organized it into two counties, Washington and Alexandria. The charters of Georgetown and Alexandria were left in place.
events.html: The District of Columbia Organic Act formally placed the district under the control of the United States Congress and organized it into two counties, Washington and Alexandria. The charters of Georgetown and Alexandria were left in place.

events.title: Lord Byron's maiden speech defends the Luddites
events.description: In the House of Lords, the young poet spoke against the Frame-Breaking Bill, which made wrecking machinery a capital crime. He blamed the desperation of the weavers on poverty, but the bill passed.
events.html: In the House of Lords, the young poet spoke against the Frame-Breaking Bill, which made wrecking machinery a capital crime. He blamed the desperation of the weavers on poverty, but the bill passed.

events.title: Labour Representation Committee founded in London
events.description: Trade unionists and socialist societies formed a committee to elect working-class MPs. Renamed the Labour Party in 1906, it formed governments from 1924 and created the NHS in 1948.
events.html: Trade unionists and socialist societies formed a committee to elect working-class MPs. Renamed the Labour Party in 1906, it formed governments from 1924 and created the NHS in 1948.

events.title: Fire destroys the Reichstag in Berlin
events.description: The German parliament building burned and a young Dutch communist, Marinus van der Lubbe, was arrested. Next day Hitler secured a decree suspending civil liberties, a key step to dictatorship.
events.html: The German parliament building burned and a young Dutch communist, Marinus van der Lubbe, was arrested. Next day Hitler secured a decree suspending civil liberties, a key step to dictatorship.

events.title: Britain and France recognise Franco's government
events.description: With Barcelona fallen, Britain and France recognised the Nationalist regime as Spain's government a month before the Civil War ended. Franco ruled Spain until his death in 1975.

song: African American railroad and tunnel workers of the American South
A song about John Henry, a railroad worker who raced a steam drill with his hammer, and won.
